jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Grow with us! Universal Investment is on its way to becoming Europe's leading fund services platform and Super ManCo. We have provided innovative fund solutions for asset managers and institutional investors since 1968. From our offices in Frankfurt, Krakow, Luxembourg, Dublin, Paris, Singapore and Stockholm, we continue to expand internationally. We are currently looking for entrepreneurial people who want to grow and share in the profits of our success.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

Conduct detailed technical analyses and document IT developments.
Design, analyze impacts, and code programs following UI/UX and coding standards.
Define, organize, and drive unit and integration testing strategies, leveraging AI-assisted tools to accelerate test coverage where appropriate.
Ensure smooth production implementation and release management.
Manage corrective and evolutionary maintenance.
Administer applications in your domain, focusing on performance, availability, and security.
Lead internal meetings with team members and project stakeholders and contribute to technical decision-making.
Mentor junior developers and promote best practices, including effective use of AI coding assistants.
Participate in IT on-call duties as required.

Your skills and experience:

5+ years of experience building enterprise applications using Java and/or .NET (C#).
Strong expertise in modern backend development with Spring Boot and/or .NET Core, including REST APIs and microservices.
Solid understanding of software engineering best practices, including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, secure coding, and relational databases.
Comfortable working with Azure DevOps and modern collaborative development workflows.
Passionate about using AI-powered coding assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar) to accelerate development while maintaining high standards of quality and security.
Experience reviewing, validating, and integrating AI-generated code into production-grade applications.
Familiarity with modern front-end technologies (Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS) is a plus.
Curious about financial technology and motivated by building reliable, scalable enterprise solutions.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate with stakeholders and mentor teammates.
Fluent in French with a good command of English.
A proactive, collaborative mindset and a passion for continuous learning and innovation.

What we offer:

Extensive insight into the European fund industry
Friendly, international and goal-oriented working environment
High degree of independent work
Company Agreement, 34.5 days’ leave, Lunch Pass card, life and disability insurance, pension scheme, Sympass card,
Office located close to the Luxembourg Central Station
